decision_record.calculation: Fixture (span 900s): last bar close 3h old at decision (10800s > 4x900=3600) -> refused; last bar close 0s old -> enters. Control (OFF) enters the stale fixture.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: the sleeve never compares the newest bar's timestamp to the decision clock; a dead Kraken/SIP feed leaves entries firing on the last printed bar indefinitely.
decision_record.experiment: Adapters3 A/B on identical bars at stale/fresh stamps; OFF reproduces the stale entry exactly.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution freshness: refuse entries when the newest served bar's CLOSE is more than 4 of the series' own bar-spans old at decision time (span-adaptive; exits never gated). First look cured the chase premium (price distance); this look cures the time distance.
decision_record.transfer: A 15-minute breakout is a minutes-scale claim on the current price. Entered hours after the bar printed, the sleeve pays the current (unknown) price for a signal whose premise — the just-broken channel — may already have failed.

switch: extra.donchian_crypto_enh2.stale_bar_gate default ON; OFF restores the pre-change rule exactly
